card.title: A PUDDLE ON A DRY ROAD

stamp.label: CANON
stamp.note: It had not rained in days.

stamp.label: CANON
stamp.note: Paid for a C-rank. It was not.

insert.beat_text: In canon, Tazuna lies about the mission rank. He pays C-rank prices and walks a team of children into a fight that was never a C.
You paid for a C-rank, old man. I've filed the price sheet.
An ambush by ninja is a B-rank at least. That's four times the price. Don't worry, I'm not mad. I'm just writing it down.

stamp.label: CANON
stamp.note: He does this in the Land of Waves.

steps: Step three: burn the body where it falls.
insert.rule: A hunter-nin never leaves the body.
insert.beat_text: Page four. Real ones burn the body.

steps: Step three: burn the body where it falls.
insert.rule: A hunter-nin never leaves the body.
insert.beat_text: He's right. Hunter-nin of the Mist destroy the body at once. Zabuza is alive.

insert.title: BRIDGE CREW
insert.beat_text: Here's the arithmetic. Three hundred clones, ten hours a day, six days. Eighteen thousand hours of labor. Gato's plan needed this bridge to take months.

insert.title: BRIDGE CREW
insert.beat_text: And rule two never sleeps. So ten clones pop at the top of every hour, and the tiredness drips in like rain instead of falling like a roof. He's always tired. He's never flattened.
And when Zabuza's done, my men finish him. Write it down. Zabuza Momochi. Disposal. No payment.
An accountant opens the nearest ledger and writes it in ink, directly on the page. The clone beneath the page feels the nib. It tickles.
In canon, Gato never meant to pay Zabuza. He planned to have him killed the moment the job was done. This time, someone has it in writing.
At midnight the nine clones pop in a line, and a whole accounting department's memory comes home in one headache.
On the last night he writes his report, the way he writes all of them now. At the bottom he signs, and in the margin there is a small crooked bowl of ramen. He doesn't notice he's done it.
Kakashi notices. He reads the page twice. He looks at the margin for a long time and says nothing. Then he folds the page very carefully, like it might break.
Sakura makes up her mind. She opens the page she's carried for two days, steps out from behind Tazuna, and reads.
Gato Shipping, ledger nine! Zabuza Momochi! Disposal! No payment!
He's going to have his men kill you once the job's done! It's in his own books!
Zabuza's sword stops. It's the first time it has stopped all morning. He takes the page she holds out and reads it for himself. Gato's seal. His own name.
You aren't paying me at all. Page nine.
Three days later the team is home, and the paperwork is waiting. A cat report. And a stack of Chunin exam registration forms taller than Sakura.
He signs the first one with a quick flourish. In the margin, a small ramen bowl appears. Nobody mentions it.
Boss. This guy's failed the exam seven times.
Seven? Nobody's that bad at anything. Pull his file.

captions.text: It hasn't rained in a week. So why is there a puddle in the middle of this road?
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: One extra line in a forbidden scroll. One archive.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And a boy who has read every mission report the Leaf ever filed, including the one about this puddle.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Sensei. It hasn't rained in a week.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: I know. Keep walking.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Rewind four seconds. Naruto and Kakashi spot the puddle in the very same second.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: In canon, two ninja wait in a puddle exactly like this one, on a road where it hasn't rained in days.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Neither of them breaks stride. Kakashi sets the pace.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Naruto drops back one step, and a rock beside the road quietly turns out to be a clone.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Why are you walking like you're carrying a full bowl of soup?
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: Casual. I'm being casual.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: That's the worst casual I've ever seen.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Is it safe to stop? My feet hurt.
captions.speaker: TAZUNA

captions.text: Keep walking, Tazuna. Slowly. Like nothing's wrong.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: The puddle explodes.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Two ninja in torn cloaks, one spiked chain between them, and Kakashi is wrapped up before anyone can blink.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: They tear him into four pieces. Sakura screams. Tazuna goes the color of old paper.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Kakashi-sensei!
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: It's a log. Look at the cut. There's bark on it.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Boss, is it my turn yet?
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: The brothers split. One lunges at Tazuna. The rock stops being a rock and takes the chain in the stomach.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Pop. Naruto grunts, and keeps the memory of the hit.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Ow. Sasuke, the other one's coming from the left!
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: I see him.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Sasuke slides in low and sweeps the brother's legs.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Sakura plants herself in front of Tazuna, kunai in both fists. Naruto sits on the second brother before he lands.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Nobody touches him. Nobody!
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: Nobody has ever said that about me before.
captions.speaker: TAZUNA

captions.text: Chunin of the Hidden Mist, tied up in under a minute. Not bad at all.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Do I get a medal? I took a chain for you.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: The rock gets a footnote.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Tazuna. Two chunin knew which road we'd take. That isn't a C-rank. Start talking.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Gato. He owns every ship in the Land of Waves.
captions.speaker: TAZUNA

captions.text: My bridge would put him out of business.
captions.speaker: TAZUNA

captions.text: We couldn't pay for a higher rank. Nobody in my village could.
captions.speaker: TAZUNA

captions.text: So I called it a C-rank, and I hoped.
captions.speaker: TAZUNA

captions.text: In canon, Tazuna lies about the mission rank.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He pays C-rank prices and walks a team of children into a fight that was never a C.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: You paid for a C-rank, old man. I've filed the price sheet.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: An ambush by ninja is a B-rank at least. That's four times the price.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Don't worry, I'm not mad. I'm just writing it down.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Four times? We don't have that. We barely have a bridge.
captions.speaker: TAZUNA

captions.text: We can't just leave him, Kakashi-sensei.
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: Hn. We're already here.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Fine. The mission continues. Naruto and Tazuna can discuss the invoice later.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Nobody sends just two chunin. Somebody's sending a third.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: They cross the strait in a rowboat, engine off, oars wrapped in cloth.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The mist is so thick Sakura can't see her own hand.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Boss, I'm up the mast. I can't see anything either.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: That's fine. Nobody can. That's the whole problem with mist.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Please don't tip the boat. I can't swim.
captions.speaker: TAZUNA

captions.text: Quiet. Row.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Then something large spins out of the fog.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A sword the size of a door buries itself in a tree, and a man in bandages lands on the hilt like it's his front porch.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Zabuza Momochi. The Demon of the Hidden Mist.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Kakashi of the Sharingan. Hand over the old man, and I'll let the brats walk.
captions.speaker: ZABUZA

captions.text: Afraid the paperwork's already signed.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Kakashi lifts his headband. A red eye opens beneath it, three black marks spinning.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Zabuza smiles behind the bandages. He's been waiting for this.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Then Zabuza dissolves into mist, and the mist closes around Kakashi like a fist.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Water gathers into a sphere. Kakashi is inside it, and Zabuza's hand is the lock.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The Water Prison. Nobody breaks it. Run, brats. Take the old man and run.
captions.speaker: ZABUZA

captions.text: Run! Take Tazuna and get out of here!
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: We can't leave you in there!
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: He's too strong. We can't even see him.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: I read four reports about this jutsu. Four. Every one of them says the same thing.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: He can't move while he holds it. The prison needs his hand.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: That's not a weakness. That's a handle.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: So we make him let go.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Windmill shuriken, Sasuke. Just like the bell test.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Except this time, I'm the second one.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Children's tricks. I've killed grown men who tried tricks.
captions.speaker: ZABUZA

captions.text: Sasuke throws a windmill shuriken, wide and loud. Zabuza snatches it out of the air.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Hidden in its shadow is a second one, and that one isn't steel.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: In canon, Naruto turns into a shuriken against Zabuza here in the Land of Waves.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: This time the only person surprised is Zabuza.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Did that boy just turn into a throwing star?
captions.speaker: TAZUNA

captions.text: Yes. You'll get used to it.
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: A shadow inside a shadow!
captions.speaker: ZABUZA

captions.text: Zabuza ducks the second shuriken. To do it, he has to move.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And to move, he has to let go of the water.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The prison bursts. Kakashi drops to the sand, gasping.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Naruto lands beside him, human again, a kunai held in his teeth.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: That won't work twice, brat.
captions.speaker: ZABUZA

captions.text: It's not borrowed. It's mine.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: He did it to me first. At the bell test.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: That's the thing about a trick you invented.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: It works even when they know it's coming. They just watch the wrong shuriken.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Now Kakashi is free, and the Sharingan reads Zabuza a half second early.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The Demon of the Mist is losing to his own sword. Then two needles whisper out of the trees.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: They sink into Zabuza's neck.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He drops without a sound, and the whole shore goes silent.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Thank you for your help. I've been hunting this one for a very long time.
captions.speaker: HAKU

captions.text: Then the Hidden Mist has our thanks.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: The masked hunter-nin lifts Zabuza onto his shoulder and turns to go. A hunter-nin destroys the body on the spot.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Kakashi realizes that too late, in canon, after the masked boy is already gone.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Hey. Wait a second.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Page four. Real ones burn the body.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: The masked boy stops. For one second, nothing moves on the shore.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Then he's a flicker of mist and a footprint, and the body goes with him.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He's right. Hunter-nin of the Mist destroy the body at once. Zabuza is alive.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Kakashi works it out one heartbeat later.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Zabuza is alive, and the Leaf knows it a full week early.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Then Kakashi's good eye closes and he drops to one knee, chakra empty.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Sakura gets there first. He's out before she can say his name.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Sensei! Naruto, help me!
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: Is he dead?
captions.speaker: TAZUNA

captions.text: He's tired. There's a difference. Mostly.
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: A week for him to get up. A week for Zabuza to heal. So I've got a week.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Kakashi sleeps for three days.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Tazuna's bridge is a third built, with eleven workers left, and Naruto counts them twice.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Eleven men. At that rate it's done by winter.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Eight months, if Gato's thugs leave us alone. They won't.
captions.speaker: TAZUNA

captions.text: Eight months. Okay. That's a number I can work with.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Three hundred orange kids pile out of the mist carrying more lumber than the village has seen in a year.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The foreman faints. A clone catches him.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Just how many of you are there?
captions.speaker: TAZUNA

captions.text: Yes. All of us.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Boss, where do the beams go?
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Up! Where else would beams go?!
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Boss, we ran out of nails.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Then use the other nails! The ones we have!
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Boss. Clone sixty says the bridge is crooked.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Which way?
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Up. Definitely up.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Boss, I fell in the water.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: I know! I just felt it! Stop falling in the water!
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Every four minutes, a clone falls off something.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Every four minutes, Naruto is damp. By lunch, he gives up on being dry.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Here's the arithmetic. Three hundred clones, ten hours a day, six days.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Eighteen thousand hours of labor. Gato's plan needed this bridge to take months.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And rule two never sleeps. So ten clones pop at the top of every hour, and the tiredness drips in like rain instead of falling like a roof.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He's always tired. He's never flattened.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: You look terrible.
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: I feel amazing. Everything hurts, but amazing.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: On day three, Kakashi limps out of bed with a lesson plan. Tree walking.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Naruto raises a hand. Night one, a hundred clones, forty trees, one very annoyed owl.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: You already did tree walking.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Night one. Sasuke and Sakura did it by the second night. Ask them!
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: I did it by lunch.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: I did it before breakfast. You were asleep.
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: Fine. Then I'll teach you something harder. How to fight inside mist.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: In mist you can't trust your eyes. So you put eyes where the enemy isn't looking.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Sentries! Clones on every beam! Oh. Sorry. Did you finish?
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: No. But you're right.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Sasuke trains until his hands blister.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Sakura learns one job and learns it well. The client stays alive.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Nobody touches Tazuna. Not even a mosquito.
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: Is there a mosquito?
captions.speaker: TAZUNA

captions.text: Meanwhile, a small boy in a bucket hat watches from the dock.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Inari has watched them work for four days. He hasn't spoken once. Today he does.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Why do you keep doing this? Gato's going to kill you. Heroes don't exist.
captions.speaker: INARI

captions.text: Wow. That's the fourth time you've said that.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Because it's true! People who try, die!
captions.speaker: INARI

captions.text: I know. I've read what happens when nobody comes. Whole shelves of it.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Look. I know what it's like when nobody shows up.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: So I'm not going to be nobody for you.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Inari watches a boy who simply will not stop. Day five. The hammer never slows.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: On the sixth morning, he picks up the other end of a plank.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: You're holding it wrong.
captions.speaker: INARI

captions.text: Huh? Oh. Thanks. Hey, you're good at this.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: The last plank drops at sunset, months ahead of anyone's plan.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Naruto sits down on it and is asleep before the hammer stops ringing.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Across the strait, a very rich man has just lost months of leverage.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He doesn't know it yet.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: On the fourth day Naruto slips into the woods for one quiet minute.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: There are light steps behind him. Even. Weight on the toes.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Nobody ever walked toward him, so he learned everyone who walked away.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He's heard these steps once before, on the shore, the day a masked boy carried off a body.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: You can come out. You're really quiet. That's how I know it's you.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: You heard me. Most people don't.
captions.speaker: HAKU

captions.text: A boy about his age kneels in the ferns, a basket of herbs in his lap.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: No mask. Hair tied back. A gentle face that hasn't decided whether to be afraid.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: You're not what I expected.
captions.speaker: HAKU

captions.text: Nobody says that after the first minute. It's a whole thing.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: My name is Haku.
captions.speaker: HAKU

captions.text: Naruto. You knew that already.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: These are for someone who is hurt. He's been hurt a great deal.
captions.speaker: HAKU

captions.text: I know who you picked them for. I know who you carried off that shore.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Then why aren't you shouting?
captions.speaker: HAKU

captions.text: Because you carry herbs the way Iruka-sensei carries my lunch.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Careful. I know that kind of careful.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Do you have someone precious? Someone you would do anything to protect?
captions.speaker: HAKU

captions.text: A teacher with a scar across his nose.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: An old man who gave me a desk. And a lot of me.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Then you understand.
captions.speaker: HAKU

captions.text: When a person has someone to protect, that is when they become truly strong.
captions.speaker: HAKU

captions.text: Yeah. I think I do.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: He is the only person who ever needed me. Without him I am nothing.
captions.speaker: HAKU

captions.text: That's a terrible thing to believe. I used to believe it too. Then somebody stayed.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: On the bridge, I will not hold back.
captions.speaker: HAKU

captions.text: Neither will I. But I'd like you standing at the end of it.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Haku disappears into the ferns with his basket. Naruto kneels where he is for a long while.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He has just met someone as alone as he used to be, and he'll have to fight him anyway.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Back on the second day, Naruto found the easiest way into a shipping company. Get delivered.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Nine ledgers arrive at Gato Shipping in a returned crate. Nobody remembers ordering them. Accountants never check.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Nobody sneeze. We're books.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Books don't have noses.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: He's reading me. Upside down. Why is he reading me?
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Because that's how I'd read us!
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: In the corner office, a short man in a small white suit counts coins that belong to other people.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Two bodyguards guard the coins.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Where did these ledgers come from?
captions.speaker: GATO

captions.text: We have a returns department? Fire him.
captions.speaker: GATO

captions.text: We're so good at this.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: The bridge takes months.
captions.speaker: GATO

captions.text: By the time it's finished, Zabuza will have killed that old fool, and the whole country will owe me.
captions.speaker: GATO

captions.text: And when Zabuza's done, my men finish him.
captions.speaker: GATO

captions.text: Write it down. Zabuza Momochi. Disposal. No payment.
captions.speaker: GATO

captions.text: An accountant opens the nearest ledger and writes it in ink, directly on the page.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The clone beneath the page feels the nib. It tickles.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: In canon, Gato never meant to pay Zabuza.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He planned to have him killed the moment the job was done. This time, someone has it in writing.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: At midnight the nine clones pop in a line,
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: and a whole accounting department's memory comes home in one headache.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Sakura. I need you to read something.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Why me? Sasuke can read.
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: I read fine.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: You read quiet. Sakura reads loud.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: If Zabuza ever stops listening to Kakashi, I need someone to stand there and read him page nine at the top of her lungs.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: That's the dumbest plan I've ever heard. Fine. I'll do it.
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: On the last night he writes his report, the way he writes all of them now.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: At the bottom he signs, and in the margin there is a small crooked bowl of ramen. He doesn't notice he's done it.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Kakashi notices. He reads the page twice. He looks at the margin for a long time and says nothing.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Then he folds the page very carefully, like it might break.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Zabuza will come at dawn. He's had his week. So have we.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Can't sleep. I've got three hundred clones to hide in buckets.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Dawn. The bridge is finished, wet with mist, and the whole crew has been sent home.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Naruto has not been idle. Three hundred clones stand on it as rope coils, planks, buckets, and one lunchbox.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Tazuna waits at the far end with Sakura.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And out of the white walks a man with a sword the size of a door.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Kakashi. You look well for a man who was on the floor.
captions.speaker: ZABUZA

captions.text: You look well for a dead man.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Haku. The little ones are yours.
captions.speaker: ZABUZA

captions.text: Yes, Zabuza-sama.
captions.speaker: HAKU

captions.text: Kakashi and Zabuza vanish into the fog. Steel rings on the left, then the right.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: You can't see either of them, but you can hear who's losing.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Haku steps between two boys. The air goes cold.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Ice mirrors rise in a dome around Naruto and Sasuke, and each one shows a masked face.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Ice. Great.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: I don't want to hurt you. But I will.
captions.speaker: HAKU

captions.text: He steps into one mirror, and he's in all of them. Needles rain down from every angle.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Sasuke steps in front of Naruto and takes it across his arms, his chest, his back.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Stay behind me.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Sasuke! Your arms!
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Don't you dare. I'm fine.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Just watch the mirrors. Tell me what you see.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Whoever stands in front takes the pain. It's an old mistake.
captions.speaker: HAKU

captions.text: He's too fast. He's faster than one pair of eyes.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: He can't be faster than a thousand.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Batches of ten. It was the first rule he ever made.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Three hundred clones at once is the one thing he swore he'd never do. He's about to do it on purpose.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Three hundred memories at once, brat. Your skull is not that big.
captions.speaker: KURAMA

captions.text: Then it only has to hold for three seconds.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: You can't be faster than a thousand eyes!
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Three hundred clones pop at once. Every shadow clone returns its memory, and three hundred copies of the same three seconds come home together.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: In canon, nobody tells Naruto that until he's sixteen.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: From the rafters, the rail, the planks, the lunchbox. Three hundred angles on one dome of ice. Eight mirrors only copy Haku.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: One is where the boy actually stands. From the inside that's invisible. From out there, it's the only thing that moves.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Sasuke! Third from the rail! The one with the chip in the top corner! That's him!
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: The tiredness of three hundred clones arrives all at once.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Naruto folds like a dropped coat.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Dead last. You idiot.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Sasuke's eyes burn red. The Sharingan, awake for the first time.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: In a dome of identical ice, one boy has been told exactly where to look.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He ignores the needles. He throws one kunai, at the mirror Naruto named.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The ice cracks open and a masked boy drops out of it, bleeding.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Impossible. Nobody finds the true mirror.
captions.speaker: HAKU

captions.text: He did it.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Out in the fog, Sakura holds her ground beside Tazuna.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Blades crash. Kakashi's hand crackles with blue light.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Is it over? Please tell me it's over.
captions.speaker: TAZUNA

captions.text: No. Stay behind me. I'm not done.
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: Sakura makes up her mind.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: She opens the page she's carried for two days, steps out from behind Tazuna, and reads.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Gato Shipping, ledger nine! Zabuza Momochi! Disposal! No payment!
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: He's going to have his men kill you once the job's done! It's in his own books!
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: What did you say, girl?
captions.speaker: ZABUZA

captions.text: Zabuza's sword stops. It's the first time it has stopped all morning.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He takes the page she holds out and reads it for himself. Gato's seal. His own name.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: But Kakashi's Lightning Blade is already running.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Haku, bleeding, throws himself between them to protect his master.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Hold it, Kakashi. Not him.
captions.speaker: ZABUZA

captions.text: I'm already stopping.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: The Lightning Blade stops one hand's width from Haku's chest.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Blue sparks crackle against a cracked mask. And Zabuza's blade is lowered.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Read the rest of it, girl. Out loud.
captions.speaker: ZABUZA

captions.text: Then slow applause rolls across the bridge.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Gato arrives at the head of a hundred hired swords, in a small white suit, and finds a very finished bridge.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Six days? Six days?! It was supposed to take months!
captions.speaker: GATO

captions.text: Zabuza! Why are these children still breathing? I'm not paying you to talk!
captions.speaker: GATO

captions.text: You aren't paying me at all. Page nine.
captions.speaker: ZABUZA

captions.text: A hundred hired swords look at the Demon of the Hidden Mist, then at each other, then at the very long walk home.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: They run. Gato runs faster. Nobody has ever crossed a bridge quicker.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: We're done here. I don't fight for free. Haku, we're leaving.
captions.speaker: ZABUZA

captions.text: Yes, Zabuza-sama.
captions.speaker: HAKU

captions.text: Tell the boy he saw true. Tell him thank you.
captions.speaker: HAKU

captions.text: Hn. Tell him yourself. Later.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Zabuza and Haku walk back into the mist alive.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A page of Gato's ledger blows across the bridge, read by everyone who needed to.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Naruto misses all of it.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Nineteen hours later he wakes in Tazuna's house, with a seagull on his chest.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: In canon, clone fatigue stacks on the user, all at once.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Fifty clones for an hour was a warning. Three hundred is a bill.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Ugh. Why is there a seagull on my chest?
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: It's been there since noon. We named it.
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: Did it work? Is everybody alive?
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: I hit it. Don't make it a thing.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Everyone's alive. That includes Zabuza and Haku.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: My Lightning Blade stopped a hand's width from Haku.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Zabuza had already read Sakura's page.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: He read it. Good.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Nobody burned a body this time.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: No. Nobody did.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: The bridge is finished. The whole country has crossed it twice.
captions.speaker: TAZUNA

captions.text: We'd like to name it after you.
captions.speaker: TAZUNA

captions.text: Great! Call it Ichiraku!
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: It's already painted. The Great Naruto Bridge.
captions.speaker: INARI

captions.text: Three days later the team is home, and the paperwork is waiting.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A cat report. And a stack of Chunin exam registration forms taller than Sakura.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He signs the first one with a quick flourish.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: In the margin, a small ramen bowl appears. Nobody mentions it.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Boss. This guy's failed the exam seven times.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Seven? Nobody's that bad at anything. Pull his file.
captions.speaker: NARUTO
